sources.snippet: ReAligned Classifier Overview Eric Hartford and Quixi.ai present ReAligned Classifier, a lightweight bias detector built on the meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B architecture. ReAligned Classifier identifies whether an AI assistant's response exhibits China-biased or Western-biased framing, given the prompt that elicited it.
